identification: Star Wars TIE Fighter shaped portable gas BBQ (Star Wars logo on lid, wing side tables, cast grill plate) with Darth Vader printed floor mat. Licensed novelty barbecue, believed to be the Star Wars TIE Fighter portable BBQ range; exact maker and model not legible on base label.

viewing_check: Photograph the label on the base (brand, model, gas type, serial), check the regulator/hose and gas connection, burner ignition working, any cracks to wings, rust on cast plate, and whether the lid logo and mat are original licensed items.
